def transform(g):
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; n=len(g); m=len(g[0]);
    # locate consecutive 3-cell header in top row
    cells=[(c,g[0][c]) for c in range(m) if g[0][c]!=0]
    for c,color in cells:
        pts=[(r,j) for r in range(n) for j in range(m) if (r,j)!=(0,c) and g[r][j]==color]
        if not pts: continue
        r,j=pts[0]
        # perpendicular rays join marker to header and extend from border to marker position
        for rr in range(min(r,0),max(r,0)+1): out[rr][c]=color
        for cc in range(min(j,c),max(j,c)+1): out[r][cc]=color
    return out
